fort.title: English Heritage · Римская крепость Хаусстедс
fort.passage: Excavations and inscriptions at the Roman fort document the garrison and include gates, barracks, stone latrines and water installations.

fortHistory.title: English Heritage · История Хаусстедса
fortHistory.passage: Describes the fort on Hadrian's Wall, the garrison, ramparts, barracks and internal buildings.

villa.title: Археологический парк Помпей · Стабии
villa.passage: Stabiae includes Villa San Marco and Villa Arianna, large Roman villas with surviving wall decoration.

bath.title: Археологический парк Помпей · Помпеи после извержения
bath.passage: The Moregine baths were discovered during construction of the Naples–Salerno motorway on the southern outskirts of modern Pompeii.

arena.title: Historic England · Раскопки амфитеатра в Честере
arena.passage: The excavation project targeted three areas of Chester Roman Amphitheatre and combined excavation with landscape survey.

nimes.title: Scientific Reports · Карбонатные отложения сооружения Нима
nimes.passage: Paper identifies the Roman aqueduct system of Nîmes and Pont du Gard. The flow deposited calcium carbonate on the channel walls; geochemical analysis discusses seasonal changes recorded by the layers.

nimesOperation.title: Geoarchaeology · История эксплуатации канала Нима по карбонатным отложениям
nimesOperation.passage: Study analyzes carbonate deposits along the Nîmes conduit including Pont du Gard and interprets interruptions, modification and later re-use.

cut.title: Смитсоновский институт · Кости животных со следами разделки из Гоны
cut.passage: Artifact page describes cut marks on fossil animal bones in Gona and comparisons to cuts from experimental butchery. The pictured object is a zebra bone. The fossil zebra bone is about 2.6 million years old.

pits.title: PLOS ONE · Сравнение следов ударов и зубов на костях
pits.passage: Experimental study uses 3D reconstruction and geometric morphometrics to distinguish percussion pits and tooth pits.

weather.title: Oxford Archaeology · Отчёт о раскопках в Уикфорде
weather.passage: Table 10 records NISP and MNI plus each as a percentage by taxon; nearby tables record element and weight in grams.

soot.title: Scientific Reports · Слои копоти в пещере Нерха
soot.passage: Direct primary paper describes soot micro-layers in carbonate deposits from lighting fires in the cave, and compares them to charcoal and dated deposits.

polish.title: Краткие сообщения Института археологии · Трасология каменных скребков
polish.passage: The article describes a bright narrow band of wear microp polish along the working edge and examples suggesting contact with dry and fresh wood.

trace.title: Институт археологии РАН · Трасология
trace.passage: Explains microscopy-based recording of wear on archaeological tools, including scratches, damage and polish.

repair.title: Метрополитен-музей · Иранский кубок с клетчатым узором
repair.passage: Curatorial record describes pairs of holes drilled on both sides of the break, probably used to join the fragments with textile or leather strips.

otherRepair.title: Метрополитен-музей · Фрагмент аттического килика
otherRepair.passage: Curatorial description notes repair holes on the stem and bottom of the drinking cup.

stamp.title: Служба национальных парков США · Керамика тимукуа
stamp.passage: Pointed tools cut linear designs on damp surfaces. A grid-cut paddle pressed into clay creates check-stamped designs.

applique.title: Метрополитен-музей · Исследование сосуда эпохи Северной Ци
applique.passage: Appendix definitions include slip (clay and water), glaze (glassy coating with silica and fluxes), and appliqué relief formed in a mold. It describes how iron, often titanium, and firing atmosphere contribute to celadon color.

retouch.title: Музей каменных орудий · Ретушированные отщепы
retouch.passage: Retouching uses percussion and sometimes pressure; fan scrapers could be retouched along one face, and tula adzes were sometimes exchanged.

geophys.title: Historic England · Методы археологической геофизики
geophys.passage: Magnetic variations can reveal burned iron minerals and filled ditches. Resistance instruments inject a small current through ground electrodes; moist fills and masonry often yield different responses. GPR records return time and amplitude of reflected radiofrequency pulses and can survey paved surfaces.

woodChar.title: Historic England · Древесина и уголь из археологических отложений
woodChar.passage: The study describes anatomical identification of charcoal and what it can reveal about the wood selected for use.

adze.title: Музей каменных орудий · Каменное тесло Новой Гвинеи
adze.passage: Documented Langda adzes are elongated and triangular in cross-section; their cutting edge was ground and unground scars sometimes colored with ochre.

hammer.title: Смитсоновский институт · Ранние каменные орудия
hammer.passage: Hammerstones show battering on their surfaces.

assembly.title: Метрополитен-музей · Изготовление аттических ваз
assembly.passage: Large pots were made in sections, often with the foot attached later.

note: Первый ремонт. Полевые случаи вместо парных определений. 077 опирается на новое исследование карбонатных отложений и устройства Пон-дю-Гар.
